entities.summary: Garo Kahkejian was a famed Armenian military commander and participant in the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. He was the founder and commander of the Khachakirner ("Crusaders") volunteer detachment, and was also known by his nickname "The White Bear". Kahkedjian was the first Armenian from the diaspora who volunteered to go and fight in the Artsakh conflict.
